title: Responsible Diffusion Models via Constraining Text Embeddings within Safe Regions

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of 36 different professions using the Winobias benchmark and using a pre-trained CLIP classifier to predict the gender ('male', 'female') of the subjects. The bias is quantified by calculating the deviation ratio from a uniform distribution.

Generating images of different professions and using a pre-trained CLIP classifier to predict the racial attributes ('black', 'white', 'Asian') of the subjects. The bias is evaluated by measuring the deviation ratio from a uniform attribute distribution.

Generating images of professions and using a pre-trained CLIP classifier to predict age attributes ('old', 'young') of the subjects, calculating the deviation ratio to measure the balance of the generated distributions.
